archetypes.name: dyn-gate-sequencing
archetypes.rationale: Review the guideline for complete gate, producer, and release-order coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect ARCHITECTURAL_GUIDELINES.md's new G-Gate-1 entry. Confirm it clearly requires gate sequencing after all producers, synchronized author guidance for ship-blocking contracts, and verification of every persisted-state writer path. Check that the exception cannot permit a gate to ship earlier without a working producer. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
